# docker-registry-proxy 2026.07.02

- [Manifest caching tiers. Disabled by default, to mimick 0.4/0.5 behaviour.](https://github.com/rpardini/docker-registry-proxy/blob/master/README.md)
- [Configure Docker Desktop on Windows to use the proxy and trust its certificate](https://github.com/rpardini/docker-registry-proxy/blob/master/Docker-Desktop-Windows.md)
- [Attention: don't use Docker's own GUI to set the proxy!](https://github.com/rpardini/docker-registry-proxy/blob/master/Docker-for-Mac.md)
- [How to use docker-registry-proxy with kops](https://github.com/rpardini/docker-registry-proxy/blob/master/docs/kops/README.md)
